messages:
Aisha: FYI customer approved a 6-week POC but CISO won't sign off without a short SLA & data-handling note we can share with their legal.
Tom (SE): Are they starting on Hosted? Any immediate Dedicated intent?
Aisha: Hosted for POC, want path to Dedicated if we meet latency and cost targets.
Ravi (Security): I'll need to confirm retention, egress policy, and whether BYOK is required for production.
Evan (RevOps): They asked for committed monthly pricing if they convert after POC (3-month min). Need fallback hourly for POC.
Clara (Legal): Send me the proposed SLA bullets (uptime %, credits) and a short data flow diagram text so I can produce a shareable one-pager.
Tom (SE): Proposed perf bullet: Dedicated 95th-pct latency <120ms for 512-token requests at 50 concurrent streams on a 4-GPU pool. I have benchmark excerpts.
ops-bot: benchmark artifact uploaded: https://redwood-internal/reports/benchmarks/3510000000.pdf :file_folder:
Aisha: Customer target was 100ms but they said 120ms is acceptable with guarantees.
Ravi (Security): For POC they accept hosted keys; production they prefer BYOK. I'll draft a 1-page security summary (TLS, AES-256 at-rest, SOC2, KMS options, audit log retention).
Evan (RevOps): Action list: Tom attach excerpt (today EOD); Ravi security one-pager (tomorrow noon); Clara draft SLA & negotiation blurb (tomorrow EOD); I'll prepare POC/Dedicated draft pricing.
Aisha: I'll schedule a customer sync Thurs 11am PT to walk through packet and acceptance criteria. Tagging CS after we finalize. :thumbsup:
